claims.evidence: The photos show the console and controllers but cannot reveal the country of origin or prior use location.
Photo 0 shows a PlayStation 4 console with two black wireless controllers.
No screen, system menu, or game library is shown, so installed games cannot be verified from the photos.

risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting to the home screen, and navigating menus
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working or for parts only

risks.risk: Controllers do not turn on or hold a charge
risks.proof: Video of both controllers syncing, charging, and passing button tests

risks.risk: Power, HDMI, and USB cables are missing

risks.risk: Original box and paperwork are missing
risks.proof: Photo of the box and paperwork
Photo of the capacity label on the console or the system storage settings screen

risks.risk: Console has been repaired, opened, or modified

Video of both controllers turning on, charging, and responding to buttons
Photo of all included power, HDMI, and USB cables
Photo of the original box and paperwork
Photo of the storage capacity label or system storage settings

response.reason: The witness identifies a Sony PlayStation 4 with two controllers, so a worst-case price is possible; the seller's origin and game claims cannot be confirmed from the photos and are treated as unproven.
